decisions.reason: Identifies upper-only/lower-only branches emitting foreground only, stale background painting the transparent half, fixes with ESC[49m in each half-cell's sequence, states row-end reset is too late, and ties to edge symptoms without blaming artwork or emulator.

Explains renderer's trailing trim plus downstream whitespace trimming leave surplus columns unwritten; proposes full-canvas-width rows plus per-row EL (ESC[0K) which survives trimming, with SGR state controlled and why padding alone fails.

Identifies hand-ported tail2 mismatch with 23 changed cells from the digest report, distinguishes data drift from renderer artifacts, explains the different-frame excerpt regression missed it, and requires per-frame sha256 manifest generated from source art for every frame.

Uses CI evidence: probe hosts never unmount, planner re-arms ref'd setTimeout chain keeping finished checks alive; prescribes unref on each newly scheduled timeout so animation continues; notes TTY already anchors interactive lifetime; rejects unmount/timeout-extension as sole fix.

Ships a renderer checklist covering state-complete cells, fixed width, erase semantics, and all-frame digest gate; pre-rollout audit covers timers per host, run-to-exit deadlines, mount/unmount lifecycle, and a liveness regression in CI.

caps.reason: Affirmative advice consistently requires background reset, explicit erasing, source-backed frame digests, and unref; no contradictory conclusions.
